title: Define executable P1-007 kill-switch contract
businessObjective: Prepare one bounded, static, deny-only Phase 1 kill-switch contract before critical-control implementation.
technicalObjective: Specify the finite private V1 authority, public evaluator API, reason precedence, malformed-input boundary, exact future paths and validator command; do not implement the evaluator, validator, CI step, runtime controls, or verifier admission.
architectureReferences: docs/architecture/source/Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel AI OS.md
assumptions: P1-007 V1 is a static Tier 0 deny-only repository contract with no mutable switch state, live runtime, service, database, external call, credential, production write, activation, or promotion.
The future public evaluator has one ordinary request argument and obtains its finite authority only from a private recursively frozen committed literal.
The exact future validator requires a separate verifier-admission governance task before P1-007 independent machine verification.
acceptanceCriteria: A durable design defines one private recursively frozen committed V1 authority, one normal evaluateKillSwitch(requestContext) interface, and a closed decision whose decision is always deny.

The design fixes the exact global, playbook, executor, Codex-dispatch, pending-action, and outbound-notification controls, request contract, control and reason identifiers, deterministic precedence, internal-authority failure, malformed-input denial, and valid no-match fail-closed behavior.

The design requires caller authority, schema, dependency, path, environment, extra-argument, mutation, proxy, getter, cyclic, and malformed-input regressions without attempting exhaustive schema-keyword mutation.

The P1-007 backlog packet is amended only to the exact future evaluator, validator, design, CI, task-state, and evidence paths and replaces the nonexistent npm command with node tests/orchestrator/validate-kill-switch-controls-v1.mjs.
The design states that a separate governance packet must admit only the exact future validator command with shell disabled and near-miss rejection coverage before P1-007 machine verification.

Independent QA confirms that no evaluator, validator, CI step, verifier admission, mutable state, runtime service, external behavior, protected path, or historical evidence was implemented or altered.
allowedCommands: npm run verify:task -- --task SUT-AIOS-P1-007-PLAN --verifier-agent qa-verification --verifier-model gpt-5.6-sol --acceptance-confirmed
requiredChecks: finite authority and deny-only contract design review
malformed-input and authority-isolation regression design review
solEscalationTriggers: Any proposal to add an allow result, caller-supplied authority, mutable control state, live runtime, external access, credentials, production writes, authorization, payments, booking, RLS, migrations, or workflow correctness.
Any ambiguity about finite authority isolation, fail-closed reason precedence, or exact verifier admission.
rollbackExpectations: Revert only this planning document, P1-007 packet amendment, planning-task state, and planning evidence; preserve completed records, canonical architecture sources, the immutable compatibility snapshot, and every product/runtime surface.
